cards.card_text: The LORD says Amaziah himself will die on pagan soil.
cards.verse_text: Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil.
cards.snippet: …be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil.

cards.card_text: Along with every remnant of Baal, a false god, the LORD says He will cut off from this place the names of the idolatrous and pagan ___.
cards.verse_text: I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
cards.snippet: …this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—

cards.card_text: One more prayer warning: don't babble on like pagans.
cards.verse_text: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
cards.snippet: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.

cards.card_text: Jesus says pagans think that by their many ___ they will be ___.
cards.verse_text: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
cards.snippet: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.

cards.card_text: Jesus says if your brother refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
cards.verse_text: And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
cards.snippet: …to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

cards.card_text: Now he turns to a report about them: a man among them has his father's wife, a kind of sexual immorality that is intolerable even among pagans.
cards.verse_text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
cards.snippet: …immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.

cards.card_text: Paul says the sacrifices of pagans are offered to ___, not to God.
cards.verse_text: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God.
cards.snippet: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God.

cards.card_text: Paul reminds the Corinthians what life looked like back when they were pagans.
cards.verse_text: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
cards.snippet: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
